fixes.what: run() spawned tcb/scripts/<name>.mjs; changed to tcb/<name>.mjs for the flat build layout.

The lock-busy case took its 'nothing written' snapshot before the test itself wrote run.lock with holdLock, so the test's own lock file counted as a write by the script. The snapshot is now taken after holdLock. Exit 75 and 'nothing written' are still asserted.

The protocol-unreadable case tampered the frozen protocol by appending one space. CONTRACT 3.18 says the ledger names the sha256 of the canonical bytes, and lib.currentProtocol accepts a match on the raw bytes or on the canonical bytes, so whitespace alone does not change the protocol. The test now changes the content (sesoi m1 -> 99, written canonically) and still requires exit 2 protocol-unreadable and no views. The unclear part is the spec's 'whose bytes do not hash' against the contract's canonical sha.
